assetMetadata.imageAlt: Two-panel graph showing a leftward money-supply shift that raises the interest rate and a leftward aggregate-demand shift that reduces output at a fixed price level.
assetMetadata.graphDescription: Left panel: interest rate r is on the vertical axis and money M on the horizontal axis. A downward-sloping MD curve intersects MS1 at r1; MS2 is left of MS1 and intersects MD at the higher rate r2. Right panel: price level P is on the vertical axis and output Y on the horizontal axis. AD2 lies left of AD1. At price level P1, output is Y1 on AD1 and Y2 on AD2.

assetMetadata.imageAlt: Money-market graph with two vertical money-supply curves and two downward-sloping money-demand curves.
assetMetadata.graphDescription: The vertical axis is interest rate r and the horizontal axis is quantity of money Qm. MS1 is vertical at Qm1 and MS2 is vertical to its right at Qm2. MD1 slopes downward through e at Qm1, r2 and g at Qm2, r1. MD2 is shifted right/up and slopes downward through a at Qm1, r4 and d at Qm2, r3. Additional labeled points are b at Qm2, r4; c at Qm1, r3; and f at Qm1, r1.
